summary: Workers walk out over guaranteed breaks, safety and healthcare.
realLife: More than 100 packaging workers struck over safer conditions, guaranteed break times and healthcare; their union said the company would not bargain in good faith.
sources: ABC7 Chicago, mayor and congressman at packaging plant picket: https://abc7chicago.com/post/mauser-strike-chicago-mayor-brandon-johnson-joins-teamsters-local-705-picket-line-demanding-ice-prevention-better-wage/17522442/

turns.summary: A small group walks out for an afternoon.
The whole shift stays out for weeks.
The employer agrees to the breaks on day two.
turns.writesBack: workers' trust in the union rises
